title: Bug: test_memory_checker prioritizes testing the now deprecated telemetry container over gnmi
author: yifan-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

test_memory_checker runs memory checks on telemetry container, which is now soft deprecated, and only falls back to testing gnmi container if telemetry does not exist in the SONiC image. test_memory_checker should now always be testing the gnmi container.

This causes test failure when telemetry container is included in a build, but masked.



### Steps to Reproduce

1. Include telemetry container in the SONiC build
2. Mask telemetry container via systemd
3. Observe test_memory_checker fails

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behaviour: test_memory_checker should run against gnmi always
Actual behaviour: test_memory_checker runs against telemetry container if it can be found in the SONiC image.

linkedPullRequests.title: [memory_checker] Always test gnmi container instead of deprecated telemetry
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes #22349.

test_memory_checker previously checked for the sonic-telemetry Docker image
and tested the telemetry container if present. Since the telemetry container
is now deprecated and may be masked via systemd even when its image exists,
this causes test failures.

Always use the 'gnmi' container for memory checker tests, which is the
current active replacement for telemetry.

Signed-off-by: Rustiqly <rustiqly@users.noreply.github.com>
Signed-off-by: Sonicly1G <sonicly1g@users.noreply.github.com>

Re-submitted from rustiqly (closes #22427). Fixes #22349.

comments.body: dupe of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22326, calling `get_test_container` just to always return `gnmi` is unnecessary imo

comments.author: rustiqly
comments.body:
Thanks @ronan-nexthop — you're right that #22326 addresses the same issue. The approach here uses `get_test_container` for backward compatibility with any future cases where the container selection might vary, but I agree it's unnecessary complexity when the answer is always `gnmi`.

Happy to close this in favor of #22326 if it's further along.

comments.author: ronan-nexthop
comments.body:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22326 looks good as is, it's just waiting on approval, it moves forward with gnmi with no mention of telemetry which is the direction i'd like to see things move, there are too many references to telemetry container at the moment for a container which has been 'deprecated' for 2 years. This PR is further along as it has approval. If we could just hardcode gNMI in this PR i'd be happy enough to merge that and we can close https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22326

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22408 and https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22409 for example of unneccary telemetry references

comments.author: rustiqly
comments.body: Good point @ronan-nexthop — agree completely. Just pushed an update that removes `get_test_container` entirely and hardcodes `"gnmi"` directly in the fixture. No indirection, no mention of telemetry. Ready for another look.
